zh.headline: SpaceXAI 发布 Grok 4.5，以半价冲击市场，专为编码和 Agent 设计
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是"Agent 基础设施的全面爆发"：从 OpenAI 的 GPT-Live 全双工语音、Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork 移动化，到 Google 的 Managed Agents 后台执行，三大巨头同一天在 Agent 交互体验上发力。更值得注意的是，开源生态中 agent-skills、OfficeCLI、CubeSandbox 等项目在 GitHub 上单日暴涨千星，表明社区正从"用 AI 写代码"转向"构建 AI 自主完成任务的完整工具链"。与此同时，Grok 4.5 的"半价策略"和 MiniMax 即将开源的 2.7T 参数模型预示着 API 定价战和开源模型规模竞赛将进一步加剧。

en.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-Live: Full-duplex voice model for more human-like ChatGPT conversations
en.observation: The clearest signal today is the shift from "single giant model" to "hybrid orchestration" in Agent architecture: Anthropic's officially recommended Fable 5 as planner + Sonnet 5 executor pattern, and OpenAI's GPT-Live delegating deep reasoning to GPT-5.5, both confirm that "large model plans, small model executes" has become mainstream practice. Meanwhile, the open-source model ecosystem is accelerating its catch-up — MiniMax's 2.7T parameter model, Tencent Hy3, and the Gemma 4 technical report all released in quick succession, narrowing the gap with closed-source. Another trend worth watching is Agent skill engineering: projects like agent-skills and superpowers are gaining thousands of stars daily on GitHub, as the community shifts from "how to write an Agent" to "how to scale Agents."
